regeneration.summary: Active hero is a v2 regeneration. The v1 hero (rejected/img_v1-selfreview-rejected.jpg) was rejected in Cora's creator self-review: The tofu looked golden and fried, the sauce read brown, and the shiitake crumbs read as ground meat.
regeneration.prompt_change: v2 prompt is Cora's rewrite of the v1 prompt, recorded verbatim in image-prompt.md 'Active prompt (v2)' (source notes/prompts-v2-selfreview.txt); the v1 prompt is kept under 'Superseded prompt (v1)', and image-plating-brief.md was rebuilt to match v2.
changes: Tofu described as pure white, soft, unbrowned silken cubes, never golden or fried.
Sauce described as translucent glossy red chili-bean sauce with a layer of bright red chili oil.
Shiitake described as small diced dark pieces, clearly mushroom, not crumbled meat.
Do not include adds golden, browned, seared, or fried tofu and anything that looks like crumbled ground meat.
The v2 prompt shortens the lighting line and drops the Chipotle Lime Black Bean Bowl quality-reference sentence; it keeps the no text, logos, watermarks, or hands line.
